forge.label: Forge — approved direction (synthesized)
forge.blurb: The director-approved TNR dark operations console elaborated into tokens: navy-charcoal ground, ivory ink, crimson only where a control writes to the game, gold only where content becomes player-visible, cool blue for the system's resting state, orchid for the one ambiguous state, orange caution, and lane tints fenced off from every pill and band. 'line' here is the boundary-safe --edge (3.28:1 on paper) because the generator maps one value onto both dividers and control borders; the full token set separates decorative --line #2a3644 from --edge.

wire.label: Wireframe (neutral)
wire.blurb: Grey-box baseline for structure review only.

a.label: A — Instrument Panel (SUPERSEDED, reference only)
a.blurb: Pre-ruling exploration: dense dark instrument console, parchment PUBLISH surface, blue active-nav marker, full light theme. Kept for reference and for the ideas grafted into 'forge'; not an alternative to the approved direction. 'line' is A's --line-ui #6f7c95 (its control boundary).

b.label: B — Workbench (SUPERSEDED, reference only)
b.blurb: Pre-ruling exploration: calm card-based bench, muted decorative lanes, 999 px pills, opt-in light Daylight scheme, white-on-crimson band at 4.80:1. Kept for reference and for the ideas grafted into 'forge'; not an alternative to the approved direction. 'line' is B's decorative --line #2a3444 (its pills border in their own fg colour, so it never bounds a control).
